svg.title: BFCL-v4 and ACEBench scores, ReAct vs Odyssey, at 4B, 8B and 14B scale
svg.desc: Grouped bar chart with three model-size groups (4B, 8B, 14B). Each group shows BFCL-v4 and ACEBench scores for the ReAct base agent (light) and the corresponding RL-trained Odyssey agent (dark), with a short vertical line on each bar showing result variance. Odyssey scores higher than ReAct on both benchmarks at every scale.
svg.text: Pass@1 averaged by four runs, Base (ReAct) vs. Mixed RL (Odyssey).
